shared_elements: carved/engraved marks on a rock surface
repeated small vertical strokes in rows
justification: Both surfaces bear incised marks on rock and share only the generic feature of rows of repeated small vertical strokes — in A these are dense columns of pictographic/script signs plus a small quadruped figure, while in B they are crew-strokes along the hulls of stacked schematic boats with upcurved spiralled prows and a mast-like standard. The subject matter is fundamentally different: an inscribed text panel versus a boat scene, with no shared specific motif or relationship.
